Technical Delegate’s Report 
 
 
The drivers entered in the 2025 Formula One Championship have used the below listed number 
of power unit elements during this season so far: 
 
ICE Internal Combustion Engine TC Turbo Charger 
MGU-H Motor Generator Unit – Heat MGU-K Motor Generator Unit – Kinetic 
ES Energy Store CE Control Electronics 
EX Engine EXhaust system
